name: Camping 101: Tailoring
summary: Tailoring training teaches you to make a Rallying Banner. To test it, you need a camp in the wilderness and a campfire.

sections.title: A Campfire First
sections.body: You can now craft your own Rallying Banner, but the completion note says to test it in the wilderness rather than in town. A camp also needs a campfire before you set it up. Most cooks can teach you to make one, so a cooking trainer can teach you the basics if you have not learned them.

faq.q: What can I make after this?
faq.answer: You can craft your own Rallying Banner.

faq.q: Where should I test the banner?
faq.answer: Head into the wilderness to test your Rallying Banner; the completion note says townsfolk generally do not care for camps in the center of town.
A camp needs a campfire before you set it up.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a campfire?
faq.answer: Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. A cooking trainer can teach you the basics.

angles.text: As a tailor, you can craft a Rallying Banner for your camp.
As a cook, you can teach others to make a campfire.
